root_causes.finding: Validation set contained only 1 single line instance (sample_page_001 line 0).
root_causes.impact: Macro validation CER across the entire split was determined by exactly one sample.

root_causes.finding: Ground truth target length was only 8 characters ('Networks').
root_causes.impact: CER metric resolution was discrete in steps of 1/8 = 0.1250.

root_causes.finding: Training was conducted for only 1 single epoch (4 samples / 1 batch).
root_causes.impact: 1 gradient step was insufficient to adjust T5 autoregressive token emissions away from initial subword punctuation clusters.

root_causes.finding: Different model checkpoints produced different token sequences that coincidentally had the same edit distance (33 edits).

verdict: CONFIRMED_NON_BUG_STATISTICAL_ARTIFACT: Experiments trained genuinely separate models with distinct weight trajectories and distinct losses, but a 1-sample validation set with an 8-character target produced an identical discrete CER ratio (33/8 = 4.1250).
